story.side_pilot.name: The Beacon Keeper
story.side_pilot.desc: A short side story: help old Juno light her beacon again.
story.side_pilot.ch.p1.sum: Juno calls you on the radio. Show her your light and dig up the signal stone.
story.side_pilot.ch.p2.sum: Carry the signal stone back to the beacon.
story.side_pilot.p1.lamp.start: Hello down there! I'm Juno, keeper of the old beacon. Switch on your lamp with {key:ToggleLamp} so I can find you.
story.side_pilot.p1.lamp.done: There you are — I can see your light!
story.side_pilot.p1.storm.start: The storm knocked out my beacon. Its signal stone fell somewhere near you.
story.side_pilot.p1.dig.start: Dig a little: mine three blocks and look for the glint of the signal stone.
story.side_pilot.p1.dig.start_creative: Dig a little: mine three blocks — in Creative every block breaks at once.
story.side_pilot.p1.dig.hint: Any block will do — dirt, sand or stone.
story.side_pilot.p1.dig.done: You found it! The signal stone is still warm.
story.side_pilot.p2.slot.start: Now pick another slot on your quick bar with {key:Hotbar} — make room for the stone.
story.side_pilot.p2.walk.start: Walk back to the beacon with {key:Move}. A few steps are enough.
story.side_pilot.p2.walk.done: The beacon shines again! Thank you — every ship can find its way home now.
